text: Splits the content into multiple focused diagrams rather than emitting one chart with every element, and says why
Justifies the split against a stated complexity threshold (breaking up diagrams at roughly 15+ elements)
Every diagram is wrapped in a fenced code block tagged mermaid
Output contains more than one mermaid code block
The set of diagrams still covers all the named stages, including returns re-entry, reconciliation, and the webhook consumer, rather than silently dropping them
Names how the diagrams relate, for example a top-level overview diagram whose nodes correspond to the detail diagrams
Uses subgraphs or equivalent grouping for the multi-fulfilment-center and channel fan-in, and closes each subgraph with end
